column1: # Naquadah (GTNH 2.9.0, GoodGenerator's naquadah processing), WO-3.3. Format: README.md.
# Naquadah oxide mixture in fluoroantimonic acid (EBF) gives an emulsion, centrifuged to a low
# quality solution; with P-507 it becomes the naquadah-adamantium solution, which the neutron
# activator splits into naquadah-rich solution (and more oxide mixture: the loop); sodium
# hydroxide precipitates naquadahine (P-507 comes back), which sodium reduces to naquadah dust.
# The neutron activator's recipes have EU/t 0 (it runs on neutron kinetic energy): the graph
# keeps them with the eu0 flag and its machine's badges (D189). Enriched naquadah and naquadria
# come from the line's byproducts and are left to the heuristic. Keys checked against the dev

column4: Naquadah Dust: naquadahine + sodium (large chemical reactor)
Naquadahine Dust: naquadah-rich solution + sodium hydroxide (autoclave)
P-507 comes back from the same step: the extractant loop
Naquadah Oxide Mixture Dust: also back from the neutron activator (with mined ore)
Naquadah-Adamantium Solution: P-507 + low quality solution
Low Quality Naquadah Solution: centrifuging the emulsion with sodium hydroxide
Low Quality Naquadah Emulsion: oxide mixture + fluoroantimonic acid (EBF)
